title: Concept: Cargo replaces a registry with another source
description: Cargo.toml declares a `replace-with` rule that redirects a registry to another source, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every crate from the replaced registry resolves through a different index, so its publication controls apply instead of the public registry's.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: Every crate from the replaced registry resolves through a different index, so its publication controls apply instead of the public registry's.
